title: Looking for help creating a merge game for mobile.
author: flaminghotcola
selftext:
Hi guys. I’m looking for help in vibe coding (or coding) a Marge game that has a main board where you merge words into new ones, basically collecting them.

I’ve been trying to use ai to help me come up with the logic but there’s always issues or it does things different than what I asked:

1. There usually isn’t enough cards on the board.

2. Or there are too many and not enough merging options spawn.

3. The ai created new words of it’s own although I provided it a list to strictly use from.

I would really love your help if you have an inputs in making this work. Thanks!

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
Which AI have you been using for debugging? Besides manual debugging, you can try getting another AI involved for debugging/troubleshooting (by another AI. I mean either a completely different AI or a more powerful AI from the same company)

Free tier AIs arent that good with troubleshooting imo...

replies.author: flaminghotcola
replies.body:
I use pro Claude code.
It’s really limited, I hit the limit after one or two prompts.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: Claude has multiple models i.e. if Claude sonnet cant fix the problem, switch its "brain" to opus may help
